Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_records, compound_structures, activities, docs, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to find salt forms; join compound_records on molregno; join activities on record_id; join docs on doc_id; join assays on assay_id; join target_dictionary on tid; join compound_structures on molregno. Filter parent compound chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL3338195'; target chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL395'; standard_type equals 'IC50'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
